Fluently is an AI English coach focused on accent and pronunciation feedback that plugs into your real video calls and rates how you sounded after the meeting ends. Reviewers mostly say Fluently makes speaking practice easy to start anytime, with more natural conversation than many alternatives and instant feedback on grammar, pronunciation, fluency, and recurring mistakes. Several users say it helped them speak more confidently, stay engaged with varied topics, and improve over weeks or months. Still, criticism is sharp around reliability and support: some report crashes, login failures, missing expected options like accent choice, microphone issues, and a paywall immediately after assessment.
